name: reafir_gate_slope
description: ReaFir gate, sloped three-point threshold curve (200 Hz -50, 2 kHz -20, 9 kHz -45 dB), floor -20 dB. Known residual: REAPER's interpolation of the curve between points is not the smoothstep Rovox uses (threshold off by up to about 2 dB mid-segment): null about -52 dB, bands 0.7 dB, envelope 2.4 dB, so the envelope limit is 3 dB
